g.text: Common-case comparison of two 8k states: exploratory existing-data analysis
A/B: pointwise 95% paired case intervals, conditional on fixed trained policies and baseline histories.
5 parents; 2 states per parent; 2 observed futures per state. Overlap metrics are not performance gains.
Common eligible cases: gain 1,247; loss 636. Parent 41013 has no common loss-eligible cases (structural zero in C).
